title: Just ok
text: Just ok. I thought I would like this more than I do. The plastic is thinner and more pliable than I had wanted. Also, you can’t use it 1 handed. The lid unlocks and you need a second hand to hold container while you pry lid off. I have tennis elbow and this mere motion is excruciating. Also, it means if I have anything in my hands, I must set them down to access the goods inside.
